notes.title: Developer Announcement | August 2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43605126/3bc17a56a4e696cb128609973c9802c950b98146.png[/img]

After much feedback on my original demo, I’ve listened and made significant changes. Prepare to experience a host of exciting updates and enhancements that elevate the demo to new heights. I hope this massive update reflects my commitment to the project. I am dedicated to listening to my fans and showing my unwavering effort to bring this game to life.

[h3][b]COUNTER-MINI GAME[/b][/h3]
A new counter mini-game has been added to combat. When an enemy misses an attack, R3-M1 can now counter with a light attack if a skill check is met through this exciting new mini-game, dealing additional damage.

[h3][b]NEW EVENT & ENEMY[/b][/h3]
Discover the new bile nest that transforms rat corpses into vile, dark creatures corrupted by the strange black substance found around the factory. Combat is introduced much sooner, as R3-M1 must eradicate these abominations. Destroy the nest to eliminate this new threat, or face these grotesque entities each time you enter a room with the infestation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43605126/c5f82958e499cc15d27aab956f7e6183dac7eaed.png[/img]
[h3][b]COMBAT ENHANCEMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*][b]LIGHT ATTACK:[/b] Now has a chance to apply [i]Disoriented[/i].
[*][b]HEAVY ATTACK:[/b] Has a chance to apply [i]Exposed[/i] with new [i]Reaction[/i] effects.
[*][b]INCREASED ODDS:[/b] Increased chance of applying [i]Disoriented[/i] and [i]Exposed[/i].
[*][b]ARMORED HEALTH STATE:[/b] Several new skill reactions can now remove this state.
[*][b]PROGRAMMING+:[/b] Skills R3-M1 can learn have been split up into 3 categories.
[*][b]HOLO-BOT TRAINING:[/b] A new simulation has been added for counter-attacks.
[*][b]SKILL SCREEN:[/b] You can now view your known skills through the Ring Menu!
[/list]
[h3][b]MODULATING R3-M1[/b][/h3]
A brand-new mod system has been introduced, allowing R3-M1 to further enhance itself throughout the adventure. Discover a variety of nodes and install them at the ROBO-Unit across three categories: Combat, Ranged, and Utility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43605126/9699d06eeaf295e7ca7e589b7ba9b97522774459.png[/img]
[h3][b]EZ CRAFT WORKBENCH UPDATED[/b][/h3]
The crafting station UI has been completely revamped. You can now queue up multiple items and quantities, crafting them all in one go with a much cleaner interface!

[h3][b]CORROSION SYSTEM[/b][/h3]
Corrosion has been reworked. Instead of applying immediately upon a corrosive attack, a new build-up bar now fills up slowly. If left unmanaged, it will reach higher levels of corrosion, causing increasing damage over time.

[h3][b]ARENA-BOT COMPANION[/b][/h3]
You no longer need to locate and repair R3-M1's ARENA-bot companion. Instead, discover the new Research Center and solve an intricate puzzle to release them. They will immediately join your party to assist in combat, eliminating the need to return to the laboratory for crafting and retrieval!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43605126/a024f86f21c7eabf6b7a247d64fc8d3c991161c2.png[/img]
[h3][b]OTHER MINOR UPDATES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The home quantum crystal will only teleport you back to the last visited connection.
[*]Expanded the Central Production area for more exploration and combat.
[*]New licensed music so streamers no longer get flagged while playing the demo.
[*]R3-M1 can now find a Tool Kit to open wall grates for some additional hidden items.
[*]Expanded the Western Corridor and created a shortcut to the boss for less travel time upon death.
[*]Minor grammar and visual updates.
[*]Improved lighting and performance updates.
[/list]

notes.title: 🔴 Demo Stream - Watch the Developer play!
notes.notes:
Johneric, the solo game developer of bio-Synthetica, will be playing the demo live on Steam's Next Fest along with composer/graphic designer Stephanie, his best friend and right-hand woman. We welcome you to come on this adventure with us and we'll be chatting (and probably making bad jokes) all night long! Come join us at 7pm (19:00) EST! 

Take on the role of R3-M1, a newly activated robot, as they venture through a dark, dystopian world in search of answers! The clues lay buried within dust and ash, data files and audio clips left behind by decaying corpses from a not-so-distant past.

notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.notes:
The updated demo is finally here with a ton of new features!

[h3]SHORTER DEMO:[/h3]

After much feedback and consideration, the bio-Synthetica demo has been shortened:

[*]Areas locked off until later
[*]Safes and code searching removed
[*]TARANA & Sagrim taken out of the demo
[*]Several maps and rooms removed for the sake of time[/*]
What was taken out of the demo will return in the full game, but now new players who play won't have to spend hours grinding away to see everything my game has to offer. I hope you all enjoy the brand-new demo.

[h3]NEW SETTING MENU:[/h3]

You can now access a setting menu from the title screen and within your ring menu while in game. The following options will be available:

[*]Brightness
[*]Display Mode
[*]Sync FPS
[*]Remember Commands
[*]Subtitles
[*]Tutorials
[*]Audio (Music, Ambient, Sound FX, Dialogue[/*]
[h3]UPDATED ROBO-UNIT & MORE QUANTUM CRYSTALS:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43543848/93ad1bba04523549a272493c3f5a6760f1cf96d4.png[/img]

You can now find 3 Quantum Crystals while exploring The Dilapidated Factory for quick travel back to the Laboratory. In addition to this new fast travel feature, the ROBO-Unit in the lab has 3 options once the Circuit Board is installed:

[*]Save & Repair - Saves game, repairs durability, refreshes Repair Cells & respawns enemies
[*]Save Only - Saves game with no repair, refresh or respawn
[*]Repair Cell - Install newly crafted Repair Cells.[/*]
[h3]FRIENDLIER BEGINNER COMBAT:[/h3]

Once you unlock R3-M1's combat mode, you will only experience easy enemy encounters your first few battles. After that, the difficulty of combat will increase. This gives new players time to learn their abilities and get their feet wet before the real battles begin.

[h3]OTHER DEMO FEATURES:[/h3]

[*]Full controller support
[*]New subtitles with shake & pulse effects
[*]Several forced tutorials that will populate even if they're turned off
[*]Quality of play updates with clearer objectives and paths
[*]Bug fixes during combat and exploration
[*]Text and grammar corrections[/*]
Hope you enjoy the new demo. Good luck, and have fun!

-Johneric, Developer

notes.title: Official Demo Release
notes.notes:
I am incredibly excited to announce that the bio-Synthetica demo is officially LIVE on Steam!

I've been working on this project for over a year, and it's my first commercial game on this platform. The demo features the first dungeon, The Dilapidated Factory, and introduces you to R3-M1, our robot protagonist! You can expect the following in the demo:

[*]Exploration, scavenging, crafting, and more
[*]Combat featuring 6 unique enemies & 1 boss
[*]1 companion, the ARENA-bot, & 1 add-add
[*]8 different skills to purchase, each with 3-5 upgrades
[*]Fully voice-acted dialogue and cutscenes
[*]There's a cat![/*]
The demo takes roughly 2-4 hours, depending on how thorough you are and if you grind a bit to obtain all skills and upgrades.

Don't forget to visit our Community Forum to leave demo feedback and wishlist the game if you enjoy it!

Good luck, and have fun!

-Johneric, Developer
